gmm.label_note: component numbers are arbitrary and were not fitted to the expert mask

integrated_gradients.baseline: section-wide mean TIC-normalised spectrum for centre and every valid neighbour
integrated_gradients.baseline_reason: a physically plausible in-distribution reference; missing neighbour slots remain zero and masked
integrated_gradients.target: posterior of the pixel's assigned GMM component
integrated_gradients.central_context_combination: per-bin |central IG| + sum over valid neighbour slots of |neighbour IG|

first_layer_comparator.method: L2 norm over hidden units of encoder_dense input columns
first_layer_comparator.interpretation: linear comparator only; not the primary nonlinear explanation

faithfulness.replacement: selected bins in centre and all valid neighbours are replaced by section-mean values without renormalising other bins

gmm_label_alignment.production_environment: not recorded in the production summary
gmm_label_alignment.note: GMM component numbers are arbitrary; tiny GPU differences in the latent means can change the order sklearn lists them in.
